subject.title: fix(nodes): resolve Unicode browser node names when configured by display name

question: Should this external PR remain blocked until a real connected browser-capable node resolves the configured Unicode selector and receives `browser.proxy`, or should maintainers explicitly override the real-behavior-proof gate?
rationale: The patch has no supported correctness finding, but repository policy requires real after-fix behavior proof for external non-docs PRs, and the existing evidence is limited to tests and an in-process resolver probe.

options.title: Require connected-node proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted final-head gateway or node output demonstrates selection and invocation of the intended connected browser node.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: Accept the focused gateway regression test and runtime resolver probe as sufficient evidence for this narrow matching change.

recommendation.title: Require connected-node proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted final-head gateway or node output demonstrates selection and invocation of the intended connected browser node.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared node-matcher design and centralization history most strongly route this proof-policy and compatibility decision to him.
